WITH combo_counts AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as rec_count 
  FROM advancedbehavior ab 
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg 
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg 
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
type_stats AS (
  SELECT tradekind, 
         SUM(rec_count) as type_total, 
         COUNT(*) as combo_count,
         1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share_type
  FROM combo_counts
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
combo_with_share AS (
  SELECT cc.translink, cc.tradekind, cc.rec_count, 
         CAST(cc.rec_count AS FLOAT) / ts.type_total as share
  FROM combo_counts cc
  JOIN type_stats ts ON cc.tradekind = ts.tradekind
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT cws.translink, cws.tradekind, cws.rec_count, cws.share
  FROM combo_with_share cws
  JOIN type_stats ts ON cws.tradekind = ts.tradekind
  WHERE cws.share > ts.avg_share_type
)
SELECT aa.tradekind,
       AVG(aa.rec_count) as avg_count,
       AVG(aa.share) as avg_share_filtered,
       ts.avg_share_type as avg_share_type,
       AVG(aa.share) - ts.avg_share_type as avg_margin
FROM above_avg aa
JOIN type_stats ts ON aa.tradekind = ts.tradekind
GROUP BY aa.tradekind, ts.avg_share_type
ORDER BY aa.tradekind
